**Haci’s Pizza, Kebab & Grill in Tirol**

---
**Welcome to Haci’s – your taste of authentic flavors in the heart of Tirol!**

Indulge in our **Pizza** baked fresh in our wood-fired oven, paired with the aromatic spices of our **Kebab** and the smoky goodness of our **Grill** specialties. Whether you crave a crispy **Döner**, a juicy **Adana**, or a perfectly grilled **Hähnchen**, our menu has something for every palate.

Savor traditional **Tiroler** dishes with a twist—think **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert or a hearty **Käsespätzle** to warm your soul. Pair your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** for the perfect dining experience.

**Visit us in Innsbruck** (or [insert other locations if applicable]) and let the flavors of Tirol take you on a culinary journey!
